source.title: Call for Applicants - WRC Members (July 2019)
source.content:
The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) is looking for about 5 new members. Interested community members of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WRC do?

- Update and improve the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). (See our public [issue tracker](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues).)
- Read competition reports and respond to incidents. 
- Engage with the WCA community for feedback about the Regulations. 
- Address any issues and inquiries related to the Regulations.

The priority application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now **until July 21st, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to Lucas Garron (lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org)**. All applications received during the priority application period will receive equal consideration, with a decision by August 5.

Additional applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until September 30, 2019 (23:59 UTC).

<!-- break -->

The official rights and duties of the WRC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2017.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.2%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf).

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

- Regularly check and respond to email (5-10 emails/day). 
- Objectively apply the letter and spirit of the WCA Regulations. 
- Compassionately and constructively discuss how to address incidents. 
- Time commitment of 5-10 hours per week. 

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WRC members to have additional experience with any of the following:

- Writing fluent, clear English while communicating across language differences. 
- Cubing community discussions, online or offline.
- Cubing communities outside USA/Europe.
- The history of the WCA Regulations.
- Using GitHub and/or writing code (especially Python, Java, Ruby on Rails).
- Project management, leadership, addressing organizational incentives, advocacy, and/or legal work.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

- A brief personal introduction. 
- A summary of experiences/accomplishments to demonstrate that you can meet the requirements.
- What motivates you to join the WRC? 
- Do you have any topics/issues that you are passionate to help the WRC improve? 
- (Optional) Any additional experience that is relevant to WRC work.

You can expect an immediate reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WRC Leader.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate in reaching out to Lucas Garron ([lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org)).

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会成员招募（2019 年 7 月）
translation.content:
WCA 规则委员会（WRC）计划招募约 5 名新成员。欢迎各种背景的社区成员申请。申请面向所有人开放，无须已在 WCA 任职。

WRC 的工作是什么？

- 更新和完善《[WCA 规则](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)》。（参见我们的公开 [Issue 列表](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues)。）
- 阅读比赛报告，处理意外事件。
- 与 WCA 社区交流，收集对规则的意见。
- 处理与规则有关的问题和咨询。

优先申请期为即日起至 **2019 年 7 月 21 日 23:59 UTC，请将材料私下发送给 Lucas Garron（lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org）**。在优先申请期内收到的申请将得到同等考虑，并于 8 月 5 日前作出决定。

此后仍会滚动接受申请，直至 2019 年 9 月 30 日 23:59 UTC。

<!-- break -->

WRC 的正式权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 10.2017.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.2%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf)。

我们希望申请人满足以下条件：

- 经常查阅并回复邮件（每天约 5–10 封）。
- 客观地依照 WCA 规则的条文及精神作出判断。
- 讨论事件处理办法时，能体谅他人，并提出建设性的意见。
- 每周能投入 5–10 小时。

以下不是硬性要求，但具备其中任一方面的经验，将有助于开展 WRC 的工作：

- 在跨语言沟通中使用流畅、清楚的书面英语。
- 参与线上或线下魔方社区讨论。
- 了解美国和欧洲以外的魔方社区。
- 了解 WCA 规则的历史。
- 使用 GitHub 及/或编程（尤其是 Python、Java、Ruby on Rails）。
- 项目管理、领导工作、处理组织激励问题、倡议推广及/或法律工作。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

- 简短的自我介绍。
- 能证明自己满足要求的经历或成果总结。
- 申请加入 WRC 的原因。
- 是否有特别希望协助 WRC 改善的议题或问题。
- （可选）其他与 WRC 工作相关的经验。

我们会及时回复确认材料是否完整，也可能邀请你与 WRC 负责人面试。

如有疑问，欢迎联系 Lucas Garron（[lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
